d: The Trail Blazers defeated the Thunder, 123-103 tonight in Portland. Damian Lillard contributed a team-high 25 points to go with 4 three pointers 3 rebounds and 3 assists, with Deni Avdija of the Trail Blazers adding an additional 24 points (8-15 FG, 2-4 3P) in the game. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with a team-high 26 points along with 8 rebounds for the Thunder in the losing effort. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 7-3 with the win, while the Thunder fall to 8-3 for the season.
